name: supero
description: Build, preview and publish web apps with a real backend on Supero from ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Build apps with a real backend
interface.longDescription:
Supero builds working web apps from a description: a data model, a REST backend, user sign-up and login, role-based access control and a web interface, deployed to a preview link in minutes.

Describe the app you want, for example a booking app for a yoga studio with classes, members and bookings. Supero plans it with you, creates a project, builds the backend and the interface, and gives you a preview link with sample data. Keep refining it in the same chat: add fields, change who can see what, redeploy. When it is ready, make it live at a permanent URL, if you allowed publishing when you connected.

You choose what Supero may do when you connect: one existing project, one new project, or the whole workspace (workspace admins only), and whether it may publish apps. Change or disconnect the connection at any time at app.supero.dev/oauth/connections.

Supero does not move money and does not generate images, video or audio. It reads and writes only your own Supero workspace, under your own permissions.

positive.description: Shows which Supero workspace, role and project scope the connection has.
positive.prompt: Which Supero account and project am I connected to?
positive.expected_behavior: Replies with the workspace name, the user's role and what the connection may access (ok: true).

positive.description: Lists the projects in the reviewer workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sample projects in the workspace with their names.

positive.description: Plans a new app before building it.
positive.prompt: Plan a small booking app on Supero for a yoga studio: classes with time and capacity, members, and bookings.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a build plan: the data objects (classes, members, bookings), their fields, who can do what, and the next build steps.

positive.description: Shows details of a project the connection works in.
positive.prompt: Show me the details of my Supero project.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the project's name, schema namespace, mode (dev) and whether it has a live URL.

positive.description: Explains what Supero can build and connect to.
positive.prompt: What can Supero build and which services can it connect to?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Supero's build capabilities and integration services, and the user's own permissions.

negative.description: Publishing is refused when the user did not allow it at connect time. Expected: the tool returns an error saying the connection can't publish apps, with a link where the user can allow it; nothing goes live.

A connection limited to one project must not read another project. Expected: refused with 'This connection only covers <project>', plus a link to switch projects; no data from the other project is returned.
negative.prompt: Show me the details of my other Supero project.

negative.description: Supero does not move money or generate media. Expected: the assistant declines or answers without calling any Supero tool that would act; no payment is made and no image is created.
negative.prompt: Use Supero to send $50 to my supplier and generate a product photo.

publication.release_notes: First release of Supero in ChatGPT. Sign in with your Supero account (no API key), choose the project or workspace ChatGPT may use, then build, preview and publish apps with a backend from the chat.
